notes.title: Update: Version 1.11
notes.content:
Hello there once again, Pizza Express fans! It's time for a new update, just in time for the holiday season! Here is the changelog:

FIXED a bug which caused the game to freeze when playing Challenge mode with one lone pizza on the menu.
FIXED a bug which caused the game to crash when trying to editing a full menu in Challenge mode after having played an Endurance game.
FIXED occasional dialogue errors which caused the characters to mix-up the player's gender.
FIXED a problem with the achievement Tough Like a Diamond which would fail to unlock if the objective Feynman Point: Part II had already been completed.
FIXED faulty objects being created when viewing the results for a game in Endurance mode after pressing the Enter key to go to the next page.
ADDED a sound effect which triggers when the player drops an ingredient on an invalid place (such as outside a pizza).
ADDED a sound effect in Arcade mode which triggers once every second when the player has 10 or less seconds left on the clock.
LOWERED the time needed for the achievement Wasting Your Time from 60 to 45 in-game minutes.
UPDATED the clock in Arcade mode to shift color from white to red when running out of time.
UPDATED the way some lines are drawn on the screen, in an effort to avoid gaps and/or overflowing. If you noticed some imperfections before, please let me know if this new patch has solved this problem!
UPDATED localization files.

That was a somewhat lengthy list! I hope these small changes will let you enjoy the game even more. As always, suggestions and reports are very welcome on the game forums. And last but not least, a sincere thank you to Silver Owl for pointing out a whole lot of small and big issues.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update: Version 1.10.01
notes.content:
Good day once more, Pizza Express players!

Two updates in less than one week? Hopefully the world is not coming to an end!
(Terrible) Jokes aside, this patch fixes a few bugs. Here is the changelog:

FIXED a bug which caused the game to crash whilst editing the restaurant menu in Challenge Mode.
FIXED players being able to create a new pizza when a scarce number of ingredients in use would make impossible to do so (meaning that, for instance, should a player only use 2 toppings and one crust in their kitchen, they will be able to create and offer only 4 pizzas in total, even if their menu would allow for more).
FIXED a graphical glitch which added a "0" in front of some results on the Endurance leaderboard.
FIXED arrow misalignment whilst choosing whether to start a new game or load a savefile.

By now, you know the drill - have fun and please report any suspicious bug activity on the game forums! Thank you!

notes.title: Pizza Express is 80% off this week!
notes.content:
Good day, Pizza Express fans! It's time for some exciting news! But first...

Ode to virtual pizza
Summer is coming to an end,
and September starts next weekend.
Back to work one must go,
and how boring is that, oh no!
But fear not,
you're on the spot.
Pizza Express is 80% off.

So grab a copy and have some fun,
the offer is valid for everyone.
Kill some time and make a pie,
to bring your restaurant up high.
Customize, advertize and get creative,
so customers will be appreciative.
And your hard work will payoff.

But wait, I already own the game!
What could possibly be my aim?
Well, you have a friend, don't you?
Then give them something to do!
Next Monday is the end of this discount,
so you'd better keep that into account.
Bye for now, I'm signing off!

Seriously now...
Pizza Express is 80% off until next Monday (September 5)! For only $1.39/€1.39/£0.99 (less than a slice of pizza!), you too can start building your own little pizza empire. Will you have what it takes to be the best restaurant in town? There's only one way to find it out!

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Version 1.09
notes.content:
Merry Christmas, everybody!

This is the update you were probably waiting for: improved tutorials! Yes, you can now say goodbye to Gastone's endless lectures about pizza making and skip straight to the most important points of any tutorial by pressing the spacebar!

I have also added support for AZERTY and Dvorak keyboards. Selecting a different keyboard layout will modify the set of keys used to navigate menus and orders (WASD on QWERTY/QWERTZ keyboards, QZSD on AZERTY and ,AOE on Dvorak).

Here's the complete changelog:

ADDED support for AZERTY and Dvorak keyboards. The keyboard layout can be set in the options.
ADDED an option to always skip tutorials.
It is now possible to navigate the profile creation menu using the WASD keys (or equivalent set).
Pressing the spacebar during any tutorial will skip the tutorial to its next most important part.
Lucky's messages during the Atmosphere tutorial now have a longer cooldown time when an important piece of information is presented.
FIXED a bug which caused the game to crash during the first tutorial.
FIXED a glitch which allowed the player to use the bottom topping stations during the first tutorial.
FIXED a bug which, in rare instances, caused the game to crash at the end of days 16 and 25.
UPDATED the game manual.
UPDATED localization files.
No snow added. Weather has been unusually mild. Boohoo.


As always, if you happen to find a bug, make sure to report it on the game forums and I'll do my best to fix it ASAP!

That's all for now. Again, I wish you all a very merry Christmas and a wonderful 2016!

notes.title: Major update: Version 1.06
notes.content:
Hello once again, Pizza Express players!

After a few months of development, online leaderboards are finally here, along with 40 new achievements, new features and lots of improvements! To celebrate, Pizza Express will be 50% off this week, so get it while it's hot! Meanwhile, here is the changelog:

ADDED Challenge Mode. This is an online mode where players can compete for the best score in two different game modes: Arcade and Endurance!
ADDED 40 new achievements related to Challenge Mode.
ADDED the option to remove pizzas from the menu.
ADDED the option to remove ingredients from the kitchen. Doing so will consequently affect the menu, so be careful!
ADDED further descriptions in the Edit menu screen when editing the pizzas.
ADDED a sound to further notify the player when pizzas share the same name or recipe in the Edit menu screen.
ADDED a new sound to notify the arrival of a new order when the restaurant is already full.
ADDED a sound effect when clicking on cells in the Edit kitchen screen.
ADDED new tips.
FIXED sliders not saving the correct volume when switching between fullscreen and windowed mode.
FIXED wrong pizzas being rarely considered correct.
FIXED a rare bug that occurred when the player would try to toss away a pizza immediately after clicking on it to serve it.
FIXED the splash screen failing to skip in certain instances.
FIXED music not looping in the Evaluation screen.
UPDATED the appearance of coins in the Evaluation screen.
UPDATED the tutorials to reflect the most recent changes.
UPDATED the file steam_api.dll to allow online play.
UPDATED the game manual.
UPDATED localisation files.

As you can see, you entrepreneurs now have the chance to remove ingredients from the kitchen and delete pizzas from the menu, giving you even more freedom about your restaurant's organization! Remember, however, that the F.L.A.B. likes variety...

But talking about the main event, online leaderboards! With the introduction of Challenge Mode, players now have the chance to battle for the number one spot in two different game modes: Arcade and Endurance. So spice up your kitchen, design your menu and go for it! The more difficult you make your game, the better your score will be (provided you can handle the heat!).

Arcade mode
In Arcade mode, players have 5 minutes to score as many points as possible, by serving pizzas and completing orders as usual. Don't make mistakes to increase your combo counters faster, restock only when necessary to avoid penalties and don't let your customers wait around too long. Sounds easy? Maybe, but there are a few surprises waiting for you...

Endurance mode
Endurance mode is pretty self-explainatory: run your restaurant for as long as you can doing the usual stuff! Boring? Not when you're under constant pressure! Making customers wait and committing mistakes will drain your Reputation Points away, and when they hit zero, it's game over! But fear not, you'll have a secret weapon you can use to survive...

Excitement!
So what are you waiting for? Glory is waiting for you! Do you have what it takes to be the best pizza chef in the world? There's only a way to find that out...!

As always, feel free to report any bug on the game forums. I'll try to address them as quickly as possible! Thank you for your time, and happy gaming!

Extra info
Further info about this update are available here.
La lista dei cambiamenti è disponibile anche in italiano qui.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hello there, Pizza Express fans!

This update is a big(gish) one, with new features, bug fixes and so on! Here's the changelog:


 ADDED the option to speed up time when there are no customers to serve. Time speed up can be enabled by pressing the keys 1 to 4 on the numeric keypad (numpad).
Press 1 to restore time to its normal speed. Press the other keys (2 to 4) to speed up time by x2, x3 or x6.
 ADDED a small animation for the clock icon. The clock turns faster the faster the in-game speed.
 ADDED mouse acceleration. It is possible to enable it from the in-game options. Players can choose among five different preset or define their own custom settings. For further info, please check out the game manual at pages 15-18.
 ADDED a third page to the options submenu to accomodate the new features. From here, it is possible to edit the default time speed up value and enable/disable/customize the mouse acceleration.
 FIXED the player being able to quit the catalogue when in tutorial, rendering it impossible to complete thus forcing the user to kill the game to quit it.
 FIXED the game playing the wrong F.L.A.B.'s gala cutscene following a particular storyline.
 FIXED the game being unable to continue to the management menu after meeting Brush for the first time.
 UPDATED Lucky's and Gastone's suggestions about pizzas pricing. Both characters will now give detailed info about a pizza the lower the game difficulty is. Playing at higher difficulties will make their suggestions vaguer.
 UPDATED some achievements to make them easier to unlock. notes.title: Update: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hello there, Pizza Express fans!

This update is a big(gish) one, with new features, bug fixes and so on! Here's the changelog:


 ADDED the option to speed up time when there are no customers to serve. Time speed up can be enabled by pressing the keys 1 to 4 on the numeric keypad (numpad).
Press 1 to restore time to its normal speed. Press the other keys (2 to 4) to speed up time by x2, x3 or x6.
 ADDED a small animation for the clock icon. The clock turns faster the faster the in-game speed.
 ADDED mouse acceleration. It is possible to enable it from the in-game options. Players can choose among five different preset or define their own custom settings. For further info, please check out the game manual at pages 15-18.
 ADDED a third page to the options submenu to accomodate the new features. From here, it is possible to edit the default time speed up value and enable/disable/customize the mouse acceleration.
 FIXED the player being able to quit the catalogue when in tutorial, rendering it impossible to complete thus forcing the user to kill the game to quit it.
 FIXED the game playing the wrong F.L.A.B.'s gala cutscene following a particular storyline.

notes.title: Minor updates: Version 1.01.01 - 1.01.03
notes.content:
Hello there, Pizza Express players!

The most attentive players might have noticed that in the last 24 hours, three small updates have been released. They solve a number of silly bugs which caused the game to crash in some instances.

Here is the list of bugs fixed:

 Fixed a bug which caused the game to crash on day 9 when playing on a female profile due to a typo in variable declaration.
 Fixed dialogues not loading properly on day 13.
 Fixed a few game over scenes where a typo in variable declaration caused the game to crash.
 Fixed a bug which allowed the player to have a piggy bank and extra customers' patience when playing Gastone's tutorial and the test to evaluate the player's skill.
 Fixed glitchy lines of text because of missing separation in language files.
 Steam Cloud now works as intended. I had forgotten to enable it for public customers. Whoops!


If you happen to find a bug, you can report it here on Pizza Express forums.

Thank you for your time, and happy gaming!

Simone
